title: Exposing Blind Spots in Deep Imbalanced Regression Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2609.25152v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Deep Imbalanced Regression (DIR) addresses a common failure mode of regression models: target distributions are highly non-uniform, causing models to perform best in densely populated target regions even when reliable performance is required across the full target range. Despite rapid methodological progress, DIR evaluation remains constrained by three blind spots: it is dominated by image-based benchmarks, its standard many-/medium-/few-shot protocol is diagnostic but not decision-complete, and tail-region stability across random seeds has not been systematically evaluated. translated_title: 揭示深度不平衡回归评估中的盲点
translated_abstract: 深度不平衡回归（DIR）针对回归模型的一种常见失效模式：目标分布高度不均匀，导致模型在目标值密集区域表现最佳，即使实际需要在整个目标范围内都具备可靠性能。尽管方法论进展迅速，DIR的评估仍受限于三个盲点：评估主要由基于图像的基准测试主导；其标准的多样本/中样本/少样本协议仅具诊断性而不具备决策完备性；以及尾部区域在不同随机种子下的稳定性从未得到系统性评估。我们沿这三个维度重新审视DIR的评估方法。首先，我们通过在多模态虚拟感知基准上评估DIR来拓宽数据领域，该基准包含跨越六个物理领域的九个时间序列外生回归任务，其中罕见的目标值往往对应于具有实际运行意义的工况。其次，我们采用平衡MAE（bMAE）和整……
tldr: 本文揭示了深度不平衡回归评估中的三大盲点——过度依赖图像基准、少样本协议不具决策完备性、尾部区域稳定性缺乏系统评估，并通过引入覆盖六个物理领域的多模态时序回归基准MuViS及平衡评估指标，从三个维度系统性地改进了DIR的评估体系。
en_tdlr: This paper exposes three blind spots in Deep Imbalanced Regression evaluation—over-reliance on image-based benchmarks, the diagnostic-only nature of the shot-based protocol, and the lack of systematic assessment of tail-region stability—and addresses them by introducing a multimodal time-series regression benchmark (MuViS) spanning six physical domains along with balanced evaluation metrics.
